resources.string: AnythingUse Local Android Use helper. Lets the lau CLI dump the accessibility tree and perform semantic actions (click / set text / scroll). It does not send data off the device.
Open Accessibility settings and turn on “AnythingUse LAU”. On HyperOS also allow USB install (Mi account) and unrestricted battery if the service does not stay on.
Service running — lau can dump / invoke.
